views.name: daily_totals
views.sql: SELECT substr(p.order_id, 1, 8) AS day_key, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM paid_orders p GROUP BY substr(p.order_id, 1, 8)

views.name: orders
views.sql: SELECT id, user_id, amount, status, created_at FROM raw_orders

views.name: paid_orders
views.sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.user_id, u.name AS user_name, o.amount FROM raw_orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status = 'paid'

views.name: user_totals
views.sql: SELECT p.user_id, p.user_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM paid_orders p GROUP BY p.user_id, p.user_name

views.name: users
views.sql: SELECT id, name, country FROM raw_users
